entities.name: Heinrich-Schütz-Haus (Weißenfels)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Heinrich Schütz House is a cultural site in Weißenfels, in Saxony-Anhalt, Germany. The composer Heinrich Schütz (1585–1672) lived here during his later years; the house is now a museum about his life and work.
